This has been happening on and off like this since late last fall.\n\nDoctor: Do you feel that the voice you hear is part of these plots you suspect, or is it a separate experience that you're having?\n\nPatient: They feel closely connected because when the voice says things like \"They're laughing at you,\" it just reinforces my feeling that people are judging me or setting me up to fail. In the moment it feels like they are attacking me, though I usually realize later that I overreacted.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if there are periods where you don't experience these voices or suspicious thoughts, and during those times, do you feel like your normal self, or are you still struggling with mood swings or other unusual feelings?\n\nPatient: The voices and suspicious feelings have been around most of the time since last fall, and even if they quiet down briefly, I rarely feel normal because I'm usually caught up in those wired, high-energy phases or recovering from them. In fact, this past spring my mood completely flattened out and I wasn't feeling high or low, but I still kept hearing that man's voice and felt convinced people were plotting against me during those weeks.\n\nDoctor: Can you estimate how long these high-energy phases typically last, and do they seem to be triggered by anything in particular, or do they just happen spontaneously?\n\nPatient: These high-energy phases have been coming and going for close to a year now, dominating most of my time with only brief normal periods in between. In the moment it feels like they are attacking me, though I usually realize later that I overreacted.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if there are periods where you don't experience these voices or suspicious thoughts, and during those times, do you feel like your normal self, or are you still struggling with mood swings or other unusual feelings?\n\nPatient: The voices and suspicious feelings have been around most of the time since last fall, and even if they quiet down briefly, I rarely feel normal because I'm usually caught up in those wired, high-energy phases or recovering from them. In fact, this past spring my mood completely flattened out and I wasn't feeling high or low, but I still kept hearing that man's voice and felt convinced people were plotting against me during those weeks.\n\nDoctor: Can you estimate how long these high-energy phases typically last, and do they seem to be triggered by anything in particular, or do they just happen spontaneously?\n\nPatient: These high-energy phases have been coming and going for close to a year now, dominating most of my time with only brief normal periods in between. The overall issues started building up about a year and a few months ago from the stress of planning for a baby and taking on extra EV training at the shop. Now, though, the individual phases just seem to come and go on their own.\n\nDoctor: Can you clarify if the voices and suspicious thoughts are always present, even during your high-energy phases, or if they tend to fade into the background when you're feeling particularly energetic or manic?\n\nPatient: Yes, they are definitely present during those high-energy phases. In fact, when I first started staying late at the shop with all that energy, barely sleeping and taking on extra projects, that was exactly when the voice kicked in and I became convinced my coworkers and wife were plotting to undermine me.\n\nDoctor: Do you find that your suspicious thoughts and the voice you hear are more pronounced or intense during your high-energy phases, or do they remain relatively consistent regardless of your mood and energy level?\n\nPatient: They definitely kick in very strongly when I'm in those high-energy, sleep-deprived phases. However, they aren't exclusive to those times; this past spring, my mood flattened out completely, but I still heard the voice and felt people were plotting against me for a few weeks without any of that high energy.\n\nDoctor: Can you estimate the total duration of a typical cycle from the start of a high-energy phase, through any potential low or normal periods, and back to another high-energy phase, and how these cycles have been affecting your daily life and relationships?\n\nPatient: These high-energy periods have been coming and going for close to a year, and I'm usually either in one of those wired phases or coming down from it, with only very brief normal breaks. It has taken a massive toll on my life because my wife and I fight constantly, my supervisor cut my work responsibilities after we argued, and I've completely stopped going to my car club or keeping up with bills and chores at home.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever experienced a period where the voices stopped and the suspicious thoughts significantly decreased or disappeared for a while, and if so, how did your mood and energy levels change during those times?\n\nPatient: To be honest, I haven't really had a period where the voices and suspicious thoughts stopped or went away; they've been pretty constant and hanging around most of the time since late last fall. Because they've been so persistent, I haven't actually experienced a time where they disappeared to see how my mood or energy would change.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe how the intensity of the voice and your suspicious thoughts compare to the intensity of your mood swings, and do they seem to be directly related to each other or separate experiences?\n\nPatient: Initially, they felt very tied together because the voice and suspicions kicked in really strongly during my high-energy phase when I was staying late at the shop and barely sleeping. However, they also happen independently, like this past spring when my mood flattened out but I still heard the voice and felt plotted against for a few weeks without any high energy.\n\nDoctor: Do you think the voices and suspicious thoughts are more distressing or disruptive to your life than the mood swings and high-energy phases, or are they equally bothersome to you?\n\nPatient: They are honestly equally bothersome to me because they both disrupt my life in different ways. The voices and suspicious thoughts isolate me and cause constant conflicts at work and home, while the high-energy phases lead to exhaustion, racing thoughts, and severe strain on my marriage. Since they overlap so much, both sides of it feel incredibly distressing.\n\nDoctor: When you're experiencing a high-energy phase and also hearing the voice or having suspicious thoughts, do you feel like the voice or thoughts are more in control, or do you feel like you're still able to make decisions and act based on your own desires during those times?\n\nPatient: I'm not quite sure how to describe who is in control during those times. Everything happens so fast and feels so intense that I don't really stop to think about who is making the decisions.\n\nDoctor: When you're in a high-energy phase, do the voices and suspicious thoughts seem to be directly related to your elevated mood, or do they seem to be separate experiences that can occur regardless of your mood?\n\nPatient: They definitely happen together, because when I first started having those high-energy phases with barely any sleep, that was exactly when the voice and the paranoid thoughts really kicked in. But they also happen completely on their own; this past spring, my mood flattened out and I wasn't feeling up or down, but I still heard the voice and believed people were plotting against me for a few weeks.\n\nDoctor: Can you think of any times when the voices or suspicious thoughts completely stopped, even briefly, without any change in your mood or energy levels, which might help us understand their relationship better?\n\nPatient: No, they haven't really ever completely stopped. Even during a stretch last spring when my mood and energy levels had flattened out and felt relatively normal, I still kept hearing the voice and feeling like people were plotting against me for a few weeks.\n\nDoctor: Do you think the voices and suspicious thoughts are always present, even when you're not in a high-energy phase, or do they tend to occur only during or immediately after these phases?\n\nPatient: Yes, they definitely happen even when I'm not in a high-energy phase. For instance, this past spring my mood had mostly flattened out and I wasn't feeling particularly \"up\" or \"down,\" but I still heard the man's voice and felt convinced people at work were plotting against me for a few weeks.\n\nDoctor: Can you clarify if there are times when the voices and suspicious thoughts are present without any significant mood changes, and if so, how you experience those times differently from the times when they occur with high-energy phases or mood swings?\n\nPatient: Yes, during that stretch last spring, my mood was completely flat and I wasn't feeling high or low, but I still heard the man's voice and felt convinced people were plotting against me. The difference was that I didn't have the racing thoughts, extra energy, or the urge to stay up late working, but the unsettling voices and suspicions remained just as real.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever experienced any periods where the voices completely stopped and you didn't have any suspicious thoughts for an extended period, even if your mood was stable or you were in a low-energy phase?\n\nPatient: No, those voices and suspicious thoughts haven't really stopped for any long stretch, and they've been hanging around most of the time since late last fall. Even during a period last spring when my mood had flattened out and I wasn't feeling high-energy or down, I still kept hearing the voice and believing people were plotting against me.\n\nDoctor: When you're experiencing a period of intense suspiciousness or hearing the voice, do you feel like you're able to recognize that these thoughts or the voice might not be based in reality, or do they feel completely real to you at the time?"
